title: Close-up Portrait with Sunglasses Reflection
coreRelationships: The subject's face fills the majority of the frame, creating an intimate and direct engagement.
The sunglasses act as a focal point, reflecting an external scene that contrasts with the immediate subject.
The hand adjusting the sunglasses adds a dynamic, candid element to the portrait.
The dark hat and clothing provide a deep, muted background that emphasizes the facial features and reflections.
reuseFormula: Generate a close-up, low-angle portrait of a person (gender and ethnicity can vary) wearing dark, oval-shaped sunglasses with white frames and a dark, wide-brimmed hat. The person should have a prominent beard and be wearing grillz. The sunglasses must reflect a clear image of the Golden Gate Bridge at sunset. A hand should be visible near the right temple, adjusting the sunglasses. The lighting should emphasize the reflections and facial features. Overlay a standard 'PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT' label in the bottom right corner.
